summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the iteration-182 service-workflow enhancements on the preview URL. Verified: (1) Service Category Master card on /app/admin/request-options with 16 built-in + 'Drone Survey Services' custom, added 'Pest Control Services' which immediately appeared in the SR form category dropdown; (2) Manage T&C dialog on /app/services/pos — list, add, edit, delete all worked with correct toasts; (3) PO PDF printer icon shown only for approved/issued/in_progress/completed/closed rows (draft SPO-2026-0006/0007 correctly had none) and /api/service-workflow/pos/{id}/pdf returned 200 application/pdf (228 KB); (4) full mini-chain as admin — SR SVC-2026-0019 create+submit+approve → RFQ SRFQ-2026-0007 → issue → quote → compare/recommend → selection approved → Create PO dialog showed 'Terms & Conditions Template' select listing 'Standard Service Terms', selecting it auto-filled the terms textarea, PO SPO-2026-0007 created (draft); (5) director-queue gating — MOP-raised SVC-2026-0020 (Transportation + From/To) shows 'Director Queue' badge and NO Review button for project_manager, while director@erp.com sees Review and approved it successfully (status → approved, owner Director Approval); (6) regression normal admin SR flow unaffected. No functional defects found.

issues: React DOM validation warning when a dialog with a native <select> opens: 'In HTML, <option> cannot be a child of <span>' (hydration warning). Cosmetic only, no functional impact — likely an <option> rendered inside a wrapper span in one of the Sel/select helpers.

Optional: fix the '<option> cannot be a child of <span>' React DOM nesting warning surfaced when select-bearing dialogs mount.
critical_code_review_comments: ServicePos.jsx PDF button uses window.open on API URL — works with cookie auth, but popup blockers will silently fail; consider a fetch+blob fallback.
TermsMasterDialog delete uses window.confirm — fine for admin tooling but inconsistent with the app's dialog styling elsewhere.
